cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Try a grape before we buy the bunch. Last week's were sour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Just one. I'll try the next if nobody objects.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, but you're holding the bunch where the assistant can see you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll hold it out like samples. You take the first one; if that works, I'll serve myself.

mechanism: A teaches supposed shopping discernment by making B perform the prohibited taste before A follows.
confusable: The lesson does not remove the known rule: A grades B while keeping itself uncommitted to the first breach.
comparison: Status-sensitive wedding access versus a shopping pupil demanding visible shared risk.
seedUse: Keep D08 sour grapes/no-tasting sequence; S05 lesson in selection becomes the excuse to make B demonstrate first.
